decisions.label: SDB01
decisions.recommendation: Immutable relocatable JSON/CSV catalogue with hashed permitted source objects; optional rebuildable SQLite tooling index; C++17 standard-library runtime

decisions.label: SDB02
decisions.recommendation: Persistent application-independent external data root, explicit configuration and backup/storage ownership; preserve existing originals through migration

decisions.label: SDB03
decisions.recommendation: Shared namespace/code, reuse current evaluators/network containers, retain compatibility facades and particle execution contracts, minimal tested normal-build wiring, root Makefile untouched

decisions.label: SDB04
decisions.recommendation: Inventory every source, retain alternatives and real gaps, use pinned named profiles with independent source/interpretation/permission/model/qualification status

decisions.label: SDB05
decisions.recommendation: Enforce source-specific managed-storage/evaluation/redistribution permissions; uncleared sources metadata-only; no provider contact without separate authorization

decisions.label: SDB06
decisions.recommendation: Preserve existing profiles while migrating Moon, then Hartley2/I3, then remaining inventoried consumers; no silent replacement of scientific inputs, weights, clocks, sinks or reference data
decisions.implementation_scope: Moon namespace compatibility wrappers and common scalar services implemented; other application-specific physical source/profile adapters remain separate work

decisions.label: SDB07
decisions.recommendation: Offline immutable runtime releases and explicit import/review/publication workflow; no runtime network acquisition or automatic latest-source selection

decisions.label: SDB08
decisions.recommendation: One-hour monitored development packages, default eight MPI ranks/one OpenMP thread and explicit one-rank controls, 200GB process-tree RAM; required longer core/science gates run separately and remain open until complete

operational_information_still_needed: Long-term maintenance and backup ownership (location explicitly selected by user)
Future distribution and provider permission-review responsibility
Separate authorization if provider permission requests are desired
scientific_gates_unchanged: U01-U26 and I01-I46 meanings and acceptance criteria
Source-specific native units, domains, states and provenance
M1/M2/M3 formal qualification and same-campaign predecessors
Actual historical core PASS membership and zero-byte reviewed Moon nightly diff
No invented observations, uncertainty, threshold/state mapping, distribution or material law

runtime_projection.runtime_representation: deterministic detached typed CSV plus existing AMPS block grammar
runtime_projection.hash_binding: acyclic canonical source/catalogue/profile -> release -> export; release and export digests pinned in input

read_only_audit.scope: manifest identities/counts and native rights locators only; not scientific qualification or permission clearance

authorization.user_instruction: develop the database and place it in /data/vtenishe/CHEMICAL_DATABASE with detailed README.md describing the API and how to use it with examples
authorization.scope: initial shared archive/API/SDK and source-preserving permitted publication; no provider contact or automatic physics qualification

implementation_record.core_preservation: running; original discovery ERROR/stale harness FAIL and corrected retries retained

native_preservation.scope: preserves historical passing cases; full CORE has existing nonpasses
native_preservation.wall_time_scope: original start through latest final report-file write
